additional_sources.title: Prax Lindsey Oil Refinery Limited Annual Report and Financial Statements - 29 February 2024
additional_sources.guard: Companies House-filed FY2023/24 accounts contain explicit Group Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 tCO2e and WtW intensity. The following page states the figures are for the Group as a whole and the refinery accounts for almost all Scope 1 and 2; therefore no value is silently converted into an exact refinery or parcel measurement.

additional_sources.title: Companies House filing history - Prax Lindsey Oil Refinery Limited 00564599
additional_sources.guard: Official Companies House filing history proves the 13 November 2024 annual accounts filing and company identity. Companies House also states it does not verify filed content; filing provenance is kept separate from emissions-scope interpretation.

additional_sources.title: British Sugar successfully restarts its CO2 production facility at Wissington
additional_sources.guard: Official operator page states the Wissington facility purifies/liquefies around 20,000 tonnes of biogenic CO2 annually. This is captured product flow from fermentation, not atmospheric GHG emissions and is never added to an emissions inventory.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency: Northfleet Hydrogen Production Facility permit EPR/MP3624ST/A001
additional_sources.guard: EA notice explicitly places the hydrogen facility at Northfleet Mill and says it forms part of a multi-operator installation with the existing Northfleet Paper Mill. It strengthens site topology/binding only and supplies no annual GHG emission quantity.

additional_sources.title: Drax: UK Government approves planning application for BECCS at Drax Power Station
additional_sources.guard: Official operator page states planned BECCS could remove approximately 8 million tonnes CO2 per year when both units are operational. Future removal capacity is not observed 2024 emissions and cannot substitute for an installation row.

additional_sources.title: DESNZ IETF Phase 2 Spring 2022 - Prax Lindsey Oil Refinery pre-flash project
additional_sources.guard: Official DESNZ page states the project would save about 9% of CDU-2 process annual emissions and over 1% of site annual emissions. Percent savings are engineering/abatement context; no baseline site total is reverse-calculated.

additional_sources.title: Environment Agency current public register - Lindsey Oil Refinery EPR/TP3633NH
additional_sources.guard: Current EA public-register result identifies Lindsey Oil Refinery at North Killingholme/Immingham under base permit EPR/TP3633NH with Phillips 66 Limited. This updates operator/currentity binding and supplies no measured GHG quantity.

additional_sources.title: DESNZ future of the UK downstream oil sector - current Lindsey refinery status
additional_sources.guard: Current DESNZ source records closure of Prax Lindsey in North Lincolnshire. It prevents stale operator/current-status assumptions; it is not an emissions measurement.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CONTEXT: Absolute Group/company GHG values remain at their explicit reporting boundary unless a single-installation allocation is directly reported.
guard_contract.SOURCE_PROVENANCE: Filing provenance establishes document identity/date but does not override stated reporting scope or convert filings into regulator-verified installation data.
guard_contract.PROCESS_FLOW_CONTEXT: Captured, sold, purified or transferred CO2 is a material flow and is not automatically an atmospheric emission.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit/address/operator and multi-operator-installation evidence strengthens spatial/identity binding only.
guard_contract.ABATEMENT_CONTEXT: Future removal, projected savings and percent reductions are not observed emissions and cannot be inverted into a baseline.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Current operator/status context prevents stale attribution and creates no measured value.

web_research_basis: Fresh internet research on 2026-07-27 using Companies House, Environment Agency/GOV.UK, DESNZ, British Sugar and Drax public sources. Prax FY2023/24 SECR pages were visually inspected from the official Companies House PDF: page 14 gives Group Scope 1/2/3 values and page 15 explicitly states the figures are Group-wide while the refinery accounts for almost all Scope 1 and 2. No 'almost all' allocation, percentage inversion, captured-product-to-emission conversion, OCR inference or fabricated UK ETS row is used.
